info.desc: Tweez is the debut studio album by American rock band Slint and the only studio recording released before their disbandment. It was released on the label Jennifer Hartman Records in 1989 as the only record put out by the label, which was run by their friend, Jennifer Hartman. It is the only Slint album to feature bassist Ethan Buckler. The album was reissued by Touch and Go Records in 1993 after the group's follow-up, Spiderland, began to generate a cult following. podcast.body: This album was recorded in 1987 with engineer Astifal Vinny. Slint initially wrote to Touch and Go Records hoping for a release, but receiving no response, they self-released the album. The resulting sound was not entirely to the liking of bassist Ethan Buckler, who subsequently left the band. "Fritz se grabó en 1987 con Alvinie y pese a que escribieron a la Tao Chango Records, para que lanzaran el disco, no recibieron respuesta de ellos, por lo que se le autoaditaron."
